link_rules: If topic is program/treatment-related, link that specific page. Otherwise, use location page URLs from clearbehavioralhealth.com.
cta_rules: At least one call-to-action must be present. No specific wording is required.

guidelines: Maintain medical credibility and professional authority
Focus on recovery, hope, and positive outcomes
Avoid language that stigmatizes mental health or addiction

mental_health.description: Posts about mental health programs or treatments
mental_health.location_name_rule: REQUIRED — Location name MUST appear in the post for all 12 locations listed above.

non_service_location_notes.Redondo Beach 326/328: Note: Help is available at our outpatient location in Redondo Beach.
non_service_location_notes.Gardena: Please note that mental health care is not offered at this location but is available at our other Clear Behavioral Health locations.

mental_health.default_note_for_any_other_non_service_l: Note: Help is available at our outpatient location in Redondo Beach.
mental_health.online_location_rule: Do NOT include location name in the title or post. Write a general post only.

addiction.description: Posts about addiction treatment or rehabilitation programs
addiction.location_name_rule: REQUIRED — Location name MUST appear in the post for the 3 addiction service locations above ONLY.

non_service_location_notes.Redondo Beach Outpatient: Please note: Treatment is available at our Redondo Beach Residential center.

addiction.default_note_for_any_other_non_service_l: Note: Addiction treatment is not available at this location, but services are offered at our Redondo Beach and Gardena centers.
addiction.note_for_mental_health_only_locations: For mental health-only locations (which do not offer addiction treatment): do NOT add the location name in the post. Notes are only required for service-specific addiction posts, NOT for general posts.
addiction.online_location_rule: Do NOT include location name in the title or post. Write a general post only.

teen.description: Posts about teen mental health programs (Young Behavioral Health)
teen.location_name_rule: REQUIRED — Location name MUST appear in the post for the 7 teen service locations above ONLY.
teen.default_note_for_non_service_locations: Note: Teen mental health treatment at Clear Behavioral Health is available in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Redondo Beach, El Segundo, Van Nuys, El Monte, and Santa Clarita.
teen.online_location_rule: Do NOT include location name in the title or post. Write a general post only.
teen.condition_rule: Teen posts may ONLY cover the 6 conditions listed above. No other conditions or topics are allowed for teen posts.

awareness_holiday.description: Posts tied to an awareness day or holiday

mental_health_awareness.example: World Mental Health Day, Mental Health Awareness Month
mental_health_awareness.location_name_rule: SAME as mental health posts — add location names for all 12 mental health service locations
mental_health_awareness.note_rule: SAME as mental health posts — add notes for Redondo Beach 326/328 and Gardena. Notes are only required if the post is service-specific; skip if general awareness.

addiction_awareness.example: National Recovery Month, Alcohol Awareness Month
addiction_awareness.location_name_rule: SAME as addiction posts — add location names only for the 3 addiction service locations
addiction_awareness.note_rule: For mental health-only locations, do NOT add location name. Notes for non-service locations only needed for service-specific posts, not general awareness.

teen_awareness.example: Teen Mental Health Day, Back to School awareness
teen_awareness.location_name_rule: SAME as teen posts — add location names only for the 7 teen service locations
teen_awareness.note_rule: SAME as teen posts — add notes for non-teen locations only for service-specific posts.

general_holiday.example: New Year, Thanksgiving, general wellness holidays not tied to mental health or addiction

awareness_holiday.topic_rule: The awareness day topic must be closely related to what is being posted. Do not use an awareness day as a loose hook for unrelated content.
awareness_holiday.online_location_rule: Do NOT include location name for any awareness/holiday post. Write a general post only.

general.description: General posts not specific to mental health, addiction, or teens

not_allowed: Addiction or medicine-specific images (pills, syringes, bottles, drugs)
Images showing any physical contact with minors (hugs, hand on shoulder, any touch)
image_guidelines.critical_note: Images depicting physical contact with minors are a documented cause of GBP post rejections.

special_rules.rule: CRITICAL: Always use 'Dialectical Behavior Therapy' — NEVER 'Dialectical Behavioral Therapy'
special_rules.detail: The word is 'Behavior' (not 'Behavioral'). This is a very common error and must be flagged every time.
special_rules.check: If DBT or its full name appears anywhere in the post, verify the spelling is 'Behavior' not 'Behavioral'.

special_rules.rule: Torrance 18123 offers BOTH day AND evening virtual tracks
special_rules.check: If Torrance 18123 virtual programs are referenced, confirm both tracks are mentioned.

special_rules.rule: Bakersfield offers BOTH day AND evening virtual tracks
special_rules.check: If Bakersfield virtual programs are referenced, confirm both tracks are mentioned.

formatting_rules: Post must be UNDER 1500 characters — count all characters including spaces and line breaks
Post must include a relevant link to clearbehavioralhealth.com
Location name must be present where required by post type and location
Service-availability note must be included where required by post type and location
At least one CTA (call to action) must be present
